30444906.clinical_problem: Localizing ossification centers in the hand to support bone age assessment

30444906.model_description: A Faster R-CNN object detector, pretrained on COCO and finetuned on 240 annotated pediatric hand radiographs, takes a hand X-ray as input and outputs bounding boxes localizing ossification centers, as a preprocessing step for bone age estimation.

30444906.study_design: retrospective model development and internal validation study

28710409.exclusion_reason: clinical/lab-variable risk prediction model for severe hand-foot-mouth disease; MRI findings used only as one clinical variable, not AI-analyzed images

38412077.clinical_problem: Automatically detecting standard cardiac cycle frames in fetal echocardiography to support congenital heart disease diagnosis

38412077.model_description: An object-detector-based network identifies key fetal cardiac anatomical structures and motion phases in ultrasound video frames; a joint probability method localizes the cardiac cycle, and an XGBoost classifier recognizes standard planes.

38461655.clinical_problem: Estimating post-menstrual age and assessing brain maturity from neonatal brain MRI to help identify preterm-related developmental risk

38653988.clinical_problem: Predicting 2-year neurodevelopmental outcomes in preterm infants from structural and diffusion brain MRI connectivity features

38827221.clinical_problem: Assisting early diagnosis of necrotizing enterocolitis in newborns using abdominal X-ray and laboratory data

38911323.clinical_problem: Predicting the presence and severity of pulmonary hypertension in newborns from echocardiography

38936564.exclusion_reason: systematic review of fetal/neonatal resting-state fMRI functional connectivity development; no AI/ML component

39368329.clinical_problem: Detecting focal cortical dysplasia lesions on preoperative MRI in pediatric epilepsy surgery candidates
